look.why: A twilight dusk lavender-violet that evokes nocturnal woodland foraging and contrasts with the silver-grey coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 0.8 m (body 40–70 cm plus 20–40 cm ringed tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Deciduous and mixed forests near streams, marshes and lakes across North America, plus suburban parks.

diet.text: Crayfish, frogs, insects, acorns, berries, corn and eggs—an adaptable nocturnal omnivore.

facts.text: Wetting its front paws softens the skin and boosts nerve sensitivity, making 'food washing' a way of feeling food.
Its black bandit mask reduces glare and enhances night vision during nocturnal foraging.

id.habitat: Hutan gugur dan hutan campuran di dekat sungai, rawa, dan danau di Amerika Utara serta taman kota.
id.diet: Udang karang, katak, serangga, biji ek, buah beri, jagung, dan telur—omnivora nokturnal yang sangat adaptif.
facts: Membasahi cakar depannya melembutkan kulit dan meningkatkan kepekaan saraf peraba untuk mengenali makanan.
Topeng hitam di sekitar matanya mengurangi silau cahaya dan mempertajam penglihatan malam.
